responsibility: This target header provides the Solaris 2 specific SPARC configuration layer. It sets Solaris-oriented default target masks and code model, chooses assembler syntax and architecture-selection specs for Sun as versus GNU as across many SPARC CPU generations, customizes EH encoding, TLS mode, section and object directives, alignment/common output quirks, pragma registration, AddressSanitizer restrictions, and Solaris-specific library/runtime assumptions such as 128-bit long double and Sun conversion helper behavior.
